notes: Entry at the open of the next hourly bar after known_at, with no time limit (DIRECTION4 section 2): a Friday D1 signal enters at the Sunday reopening, an index signal of the session close at the next session's open.

An H4/D1 value is stamped known at its block's scheduled end (17, 21, 01, 05, 09, 13 New York); where a block's bars stop early this is later than its last hourly bar's end, but no hourly bar lies in between, so the entry bar of every rule and the F1/F2 trend of H4/D1 signals are the same as with the end of the last hourly bar; an H1 signal on the last bar of an H4 block that stops early sees the previous H4 block for F1/F2 (GRAMMAR.md section 1).
K05/K06 compare the range with the ATR(20) of the previous bar; K07's 38.2 % is measured on the shock bar's close-to-close move (GRAMMAR.md section 3).
Siblings: the other exit, plus the neighbouring parameter along T01-T03, T06-T07, R01-R03, K01-K02, K03-K04 only; every other signal has only its other-exit sibling (GRAMMAR.md section 8).
F1/F2 use the last H4 bar known at the signal's known_at (GRAMMAR.md section 4).

Signals needing 500 bars (K01-K04, K07, H05) have no D1 signal before about 2015, T03 on D1 none before about late 2013: those D1 rules need 4 positive years out of about 4 usable ones (as pre-registered).
share_t_gt_2 counts every rule-unit; rule-units with few trades have huge, noisy t, so the shares and median t over the rule-units with n >= 30 are given beside it; no mean or sd of t is reported.
